items.stem:
Shiksha Sadan University is setting up its campus in Varanasi with four blocks: DESIGN, SALES, LOGISTICS, HOSTEL. Its head office is in Nagpur, about 1800 km away.
Distances between the blocks:
DESIGN to SALES: 75 m
DESIGN to LOGISTICS: 45 m
DESIGN to HOSTEL: 265 m
SALES to LOGISTICS: 265 m
SALES to HOSTEL: 80 m
LOGISTICS to HOSTEL: 295 m
Number of computers in each block:
DESIGN: 56
SALES: 102
LOGISTICS: 17
HOSTEL: 37
(i) Suggest the most suitable block to house the server, with a reason.
(ii) Suggest a cable layout (block to block) for connecting the blocks efficiently.
(iii) Between which blocks should a repeater be placed, if the layout in (ii) is used and Ethernet cable is used for connections?
(iv) Which device should be used to connect all the computers within each block?
(v) Which protocol should be used to transfer large files from the campus server to the head office?
items.answer:
(i) SALES, because it has the maximum number of computers (102); most traffic stays within the block (80:20 rule).
(ii) Star layout with SALES at the centre: SALES–DESIGN, SALES–LOGISTICS, SALES–HOSTEL.
(iii) Between SALES and LOGISTICS (265 m), as the distance is more than 100 m.
(iv) A switch (an intelligent device that sends data only to the intended computer).
(v) FTP (File Transfer Protocol).
items.markingKey: 1 mark for each part (i)–(v); in (ii) any efficient layout centred on the server block earns the mark.

items.stem:
Kalpana Design Studio is setting up its campus in Surat with four blocks: LIBRARY, TRAINING, ACADEMIC, HOSTEL. Its head office is in Coimbatore, about 1800 km away.
Distances between the blocks:
LIBRARY to TRAINING: 235 m
LIBRARY to ACADEMIC: 105 m
LIBRARY to HOSTEL: 180 m
TRAINING to ACADEMIC: 280 m
TRAINING to HOSTEL: 100 m
ACADEMIC to HOSTEL: 65 m
Number of computers in each block:
LIBRARY: 53
TRAINING: 155
ACADEMIC: 68
HOSTEL: 47
(i) Suggest the most suitable block to house the server, with a reason.
(ii) Suggest a cable layout (block to block) for connecting the blocks efficiently.
(iii) Between which blocks should a repeater be placed, if the layout in (ii) is used and Ethernet cable is used for connections?
(iv) Suggest a suitable topology for connecting the computers inside each block, and the device at its centre.
(v) Suggest the protocol or technology for making voice calls over the Internet between the campus and the head office.
items.answer:
(i) TRAINING, because it has the maximum number of computers (155); most traffic stays within the block (80:20 rule).
(ii) Star layout with TRAINING at the centre: TRAINING–LIBRARY, TRAINING–ACADEMIC, TRAINING–HOSTEL.
(iii) Between TRAINING and LIBRARY (235 m), TRAINING and ACADEMIC (280 m), as the distance is more than 100 m.
(iv) Star topology with a switch at the centre of each block.
(v) VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol).
items.markingKey: 1 mark for each part (i)–(v); in (ii) any efficient layout centred on the server block earns the mark.
